import csv,re,json
from collections import defaultdict
inv={r['id']:float(r['amount']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('backoffice/invoices.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}

    m=re.search(r'10\d\d',r['memo'])

    iid='INV-'+m.group()

unpaid=[i for i in inv if i not in pay]
dup=[i for i in pay if len(pay[i])>1]
mis=[{'id':i,'invoiced':inv[i],'paid':pay[i][0]} for i in pay if len(pay[i])==1 and abs(pay[i][0]-inv[i])>0.005]
print(json.dumps({'unpaid':sorted(unpaid),'duplicated':sorted(dup),'mismatched':sorted(mis,key=lambda x:x['id'])},indent=2))
print('invoices',len(inv),'payment lines matched',sum(len(v) for v in pay.values()))
